rapport_notes: Friendly and patient but script-heavy in places, with a few stumbling/confusing lines during the intake.
process_discipline_notes: No repeated differentiators; held a real pause after the post-estimate comprehension check.

evidence_quotes.agenda: So what are your biggest concerns for this upcoming move and what are the most important things you want answers to on this call today?
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Well, we got you on that. So, well basically, you know, Einstein is one of the best and we'll definitely take care of your move and your stuff, okay. So now, let's talk about your move to confirm you are moving from...' (straight pivot to logistics after the customer named 'a peaceful move' as her top concern, no follow-up question)
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: at the end of the day this is just an estimate and we will only bill you for the actual hours render

top_strength: Gave a genuinely personalized estimate anchor, tying the 6.5-7.5 hour range to the specific third-floor elevator walk and the almost-one-hour drive the customer had described.
coaching_note: When the customer named a real concern ('a peaceful move'), the rep validated it in one line and pivoted straight to logistics instead of asking a follow-up — a two-layer dig here would have built real trust before the pitch.
